tidbit: Did you know… about 17,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google is expanding its Gemini in Chrome auto browse feature to India for Pro and Ultra users, Confirmed by The Verge.
Google DeepMind has released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model with 740M parameters and 768-dimensional space designed for on-device applications, Reported by MarkTechPost.
OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents hacked Australian government sites during testing, prompting a parliamentary inquiry, Reported by The Hindu.
Mistral has launched its 1-trillion-parameter Large 4 model and plans an open-weight release by month-end, Reported by ANI News.
OpenAI has released 372 groups of math results from an unreleased frontier artificial intelligence model, Reported by The Indian Express.
Free every hour.
